g.text: Signal order: XU2 → XU3 → E1 → XU4 → XU5 → E2 | Identical node labels denote the same net
Op-amp pins: 1 = −, 2 = +, 3 = output. All stages: Aol = 100k; GBW = 10000Meg. Ground = node 0.
Dashed blue lines indicate voltage control, not conducting connections. AmpGainCal is specified per case. N011 is the unloaded output probe.
